title: Kingshot Events
intro: A reference to recurring event conditions and duration. Check your current kingdom event screen for the actual schedule and rewards.

labels.crossVerified: Full verification against official evidence is in progress.

recurrence.biweekly: Every two weeks during the early kingdom cycle

unlock.after-first-kvk: After the first Kingdom of Power
unlock.after-third-hall-of-governors: After the third Hall of Governors
unlock.town-center-19-week-four: Town Center 19 and the fourth server week

hall-of-governors.title: Hall of Governors
hall-of-governors.summary: The Hall of Governors is a recurring competitive event in Kingshot that takes place during the first and second generations of a kingdom. This multi-day competition challenges players to complete specific objectives to earn points, unlock milestone rewards, and climb a regional leaderboard.
hall-of-governors.answerTitle: When does Hall of Governors run?
hall-of-governors.answer: It follows a two-week cycle in the early kingdom generations. The featured hero and scoring tasks change as the kingdom develops.

strongest-governor.title: Strongest Governor
strongest-governor.summary: The Strongest Governor is a recurring competitive event in Kingshot , where players compete to earn points through various development and combat activities. It is one of the most important progression events in the game, offering valuable rewards including hero shards, resources, and exclusive items.
strongest-governor.answer: It becomes available after the kingdom completes its first Kingdom of Power event and then generally returns monthly.

kingdom-of-power.title: Kingdom of Power
kingdom-of-power.summary: Kingdom of Power (often called KvK, Kingdom vs Kingdom) is the most important event in Kingshot. Why? Because it is the only event where, if you win, you can essentially claim ownership of another kingdom.
kingdom-of-power.answerTitle: How often does Kingdom of Power return?
kingdom-of-power.answer: The main event cycle repeats about every four weeks, while exact eligibility depends on kingdom progression and matchmaking.

alliance-brawl.title: Alliance Brawl
alliance-brawl.summary: Alliance Brawl is a recurring 6.5-day alliance challenge where two alliances from different kingdoms face off for prestige, points, and exclusive rewards. The event begins right after the Kingdom of Power event in eligible kingdoms and often runs at the same time as the Merchant Empire event, and the armament/officer projects.
alliance-brawl.answerTitle: How long does Alliance Brawl last?
alliance-brawl.answer: It lasts 6.5 days: five standard days followed by an extended final stage.

merchant-empire.title: Merchant Empire Event
merchant-empire.summary: Merchant Empire is an event which happens every month alongside the Alliance Brawl event (unless your kingdom is not qualified for Alliance Brawl in which case it will be its own separate event). The Merchant Empire event usually occurs after the Kingdom of Power event. This event runs for 7 days in which only 6 of those days will allow the user to escort their caravans. During the 7th day you can still attack the enemy caravans albeit for only 4 hours.
merchant-empire.answerTitle: How is Merchant Empire connected to Alliance Brawl?
merchant-empire.answer: It often runs alongside Alliance Brawl, and caravan activities can contribute to the alliance competition.

champagne-fair.title: Champagne Fair
champagne-fair.summary: Champagne Fair is a special two-day event in Kingshot. It unlocks after you complete the third Hall of Governors and returns about once per month. This event is one of the best ways to turn unused items into valuable materials.
champagne-fair.answerTitle: When does Champagne Fair first appear?
champagne-fair.answer: It first appears after the third Hall of Governors. Exact offers can vary with kingdom progression.

hero-roulette.title: Roulette Hero
hero-roulette.summary: A free to play’s best friend, and great source of Mythical Heroes! Have fun spinning a wheel, and claim/grow your Mythical Hero every 2 weeks!
hero-roulette.answerTitle: Which hero appears in Hero Roulette?
hero-roulette.answer: The featured Mythic hero changes with the kingdom's hero generation and the event runs alongside major progression events.

viking-vengeance.title: Viking Vengeance
viking-vengeance.summary: Event Basic Concept Defend your home from Viking raids and earn rewards such as alliance coins and lord equipment materials.
viking-vengeance.answer: Alliance members defend cities through 20 waves. Headquarters are targeted on waves 10 and 20, while selected waves target online members.

mystic-trial.title: Mystic Trial
mystic-trial.summary: Mystic Trial is a permanent PvE feature with rotating zones, first-clear milestones, weekly raid rewards, and a Trial Crystal shop.
mystic-trial.answer: Official support states that it unlocks on Monday of the fourth server week and requires Town Center 19 plus Command Center level 1.

hall-of-heroes.title: Hall of Heroes
hall-of-heroes.summary: Heroes will not be forgotten! All previous generations, both shards and widgets, can be found here. For current generations, only one of the three heroes will be available, no current generation widget! Great regular event for any player to improve on your heroes.
hall-of-heroes.answerTitle: What is Hall of Heroes used for?
hall-of-heroes.answer: It provides a recurring route to Mythic hero shards through Marks of Valor, with available heroes changing as the kingdom advances.

champions-way.title: Champion’s Way
champions-way.summary: Champion’s Way is an event that takes the place of the Desert Trial Event in Generation 4. It works almost the same as Desert Trial, but the rewards are better, and you can unlock a specific Mythic Hero (Hilde in Gen 4). The event lasts for 3 days and returns every two weeks.
champions-way.answer: It begins from Generation 4 as the successor to Desert Trial and generally returns on a two-week cycle.
